scope: Theorem 4.4 (Positive-entropy measure classification) of the manuscript “Equidistribution of primitive quartic torus packets for arbitrary orders” (preprints/Equidistribution-of-Primitive-Quartic-Torus-Packets-for-Arbitrary-Orders-October-5-2026/quartic-torus-packets.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 015 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 95c2a937da74097a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For n ≥ 3, let An be the group of positive diagonal matrices in SLn(R). Let ν be an An-invariant and An-ergodic probability on SLn(R)/SLn(Z), with the left action. If hν(a0(1)) > 0 for some one-parameter subgroup a0 : R → An, then there are a closed connected subgroup L ⊂ SLn(R) containing An and a point x such that Lx is closed and ν is the L-invariant probability on Lx.
